item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Trailer Will Give Veteran Fans Goosebumps
item.description:
Bloody Tears... Need we say more?
Konami has released a new trailer for Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, and it's a doozy.
We see a load of gameplay, of course, but the coolest thing about this latest trailer is that it's got the iconic Bloody Tears track playing in the background – a really nice rendition of it, too.
Otherwise, this is definitely looking like one of the most radical reinventions the series has ever been through. Yes, it's still got that 'Igavania' vibe to it, but the action looks a lot more fast-paced, with more options for attacks and traversal.
Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube851k
Belmont's Curse launches on 15th October 2026 for the Switch. We're still a little miffed there's no Switch 2 version for this, so we've got our fingers crossed that it will run okay. At the very least, we're hoping it'll get some sort of 60fps mode at some point like Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound, so that it can take advantage of the Switch 2's extra power.
Launching on Switch this October
Konami's 2D action-exploration game arrives this October
Nice trailer, huh? What are your thoughts on this? Leave a comment down below and let us know.

item.title: Nintendo Download: 3rd September (North America)
item.description:
Orbitals! Onimusha! Valheim!
The latest Nintendo Download update for North America has arrived, and it's bringing new games galore to the eShop. As always, be sure to drop a vote in our poll and comment down below with your potential picks for the week. Enjoy!
Orbitals (Kepler Interactive, 3rd Sep, $39.99) - Blast off with Maki and Omura as they brave the deadly Storm Wall and the perils beyond to save their home. This intergalactic two-player co-op adventure set in a retro anime-inspired universe rewards smart teamwork and clear communication. - Read our Orbitals review
Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube851k
NBA 2K27 (2K, 4th Sep, $69.99) - The hustle doesn’t stop in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality. Master your skills with new gameplay animations directly translated from real NBA action. Use an array of ProPLAY features to cook defenders with crossovers, show off your range with enhanced shooting mechanics and become a matchup nightmare every time you step on the court. For the first time in MyCAREER, play through NBA history and compete against legends from five iconic eras, with a legacy-defining story in the Modern Era. Create a MyPLAYER that transcends playstyles and rewrite the book on your way to the Hall of Fame.
Onimusha: Way of the Sword (CAPCOM, 4th Sep, $69.99) - Fight through intense swordplay action and explore a dark fantasy Kyoto overrun by other worldly invaders in this action game. Take up the sword as Miyamoto Musashi, a fierce young samurai whose legend is etched in Japanese history, and drive back the monstrous Genma into the underworld. Enjoy the swordplay combat even more with motion controls made possible with the Joy-Con 2 controllers. - Read our Onimusha: Way of the Sword review
Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault (11 bit studios, 2nd Sep, $29.99) - Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Each run becomes a tactical puzzle of how far you dare to explore and how much loot you can carry back. After each escapade, put your hard-earned treasure on sale! Set your prices, grow your shop, entice returning customers and make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.- Read our Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault review
Asdivine Knot – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition (KEMCO, 3rd Sep, $18.89) - A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world. Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization.
BioEden (Focus Entertainment, 3rd Sep, $21.99) - BioEden is a cozy management game where you'll build a self-sustaining network of structures, all working in harmony to bring extinct animals back to life. As a Keeper, you've been entrusted by the Cosmic Collective to bring life back to a distressed planet. Use patience, care, and a little ingenuity to restore the planet, one balanced ecosystem at a time. From managing power grids and water networks to purifying lakes and recycling old structures, every decision you make inches the planet closer to life. As your domes connect and your ecological economy grows, you'll craft the perfect biomes to welcome dozens of wonderful animal species back into the world.
Console Archives BUBBLE BOBBLE (HAMSTER, 26th Aug, $7.99) - "BUBBLE BOBBLE" was released by TAITO in 1988 for an 8-bit home console. This is an action game where Bub and Bob, transformed into Bubble Dragons, go on an adventure to rescue their girlfriends, Betty and Patty, who have been kidnapped by a wizard. The game features 100 stages in total. What will happen if you clear Stage 100 and see the "True ending". . . ?
Jenny LeClue – Detectivu (Mografi, 7th Sep, $24.99) - Unravel The Spoken Secrets Edition! •Runs in 1080p handheld and 4k 60fps docked! •A 8+ Hour Adventure filled with mystery, suspense, a nd bad jokes! • Now Featuring voice acting for the entire game!!! • Play Jenny LeClue like an animated movie with new auto-play dialogue options!
Mewgenics (Nicalis, 8th Sep, $39.99) - Build the ultimate cat army through tactical breeding and send them into deep, challenging turn-based adventures. Draft abilities, collect items, and manipulate genetics across generations in this roguelike tactics game from the creators of The Binding of Isaac and The End is Nigh.
Mind Diver (PLAYISM, 27th Aug, $16.19) - You are a Mind Diver. Using experimental technology, you explore Lina's Mind Ocean, fixing her memories to solve an unprecedented missing persons case. Lina's subconscious hides many secrets, critical to unraveling the dark case. Learn about her missing boyfriend, his secrets, and a party hiding something deeply ominous. Listen to conversations from the past and use your own deduction to piece together the course of events.
Model Debut4 (FURYU Corporation, 26th Aug, $39.99) - As a rookie model, you set your sights on becoming the No. 1 model, the "Top of nicola," at the "nicola Show," a special runway held once a year! Take on dream jobs such as magazine modeling, TV appearances, and brand image modeling, and grow as a model with fashion that expresses your unique style! You'll also produce two fellow models and help energize the small agency you belong to! Fashion, work, romance, and friendship—a sparkling life where you can enjoy it all awaits!
MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice (Bandai Namco Entertainment, 4th Sep, $59.99) - SMASH through your enemies in MY HERO ACADEMIA: All's Justice! Take control of spectacular 3v3 battles, and experience U.A. High hero training and the climatic Final War! Dive into a variety of game modes, including "Team Up Mission" where you'll experience hero life as a U.A. High 1-A student in a Virtual Space, "Story Mode" where you can relive the Final War storyline, "Archives Battle Mode" where you can experience past iconic battles, and more!
SPRAWL zero (Kwalee, 8th Sep, $24.99) - Sprawl Zero is a first-person shooter inspired by 2000s console FPS games. Both the aesthetics and design sensibility call back to the Golden Age where the genre evolved from shooting in corridors to building worlds.
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Arcade: Wrath of The Mutants – Ninja Edition (Trailmark Games, 4th Sep, $29.99) - Re-experience the 2017 arcade classic with 3 additional stages and 6 additional boss battles! Take control of Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello or Raphael in this classic beat-em-up inspired by the cult favorite Turtles in Time. Play with your friends through local co-op and dominate the Foot Clan to foil the Shredder’s maniacal plan. - Read our Switch 1 review
Not quite a cowablunder
Valheim (Coffee Stain, 9th Sep, $29.99) - Discover an immersive procedurally generated world, with different biomes that each have their distinct environments, unique resources and dang erous enemies. Become a Viking and sail the open seas in search of lands unknown, alone or with up to nine friends!
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Complete Edition (KOEI TECMO AMERICA, 3rd Sep, $59.99) - From the depths of darkness, a dragon soars. Worldwide praise for the dark Three Kingdoms action RPG Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty has resulted in the creation of a complete edition of the game, including all three DLCs with a wide variety of additional content, from new weapons, to new scenarios and characters, to new Divine Beasts.- Read our Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Complete Edition review
4096 Space Traders Era (Pix Arts, 4th Sep, $9.99) - Chart your fortune across a living galaxy. In 4096 Space Traders Era, you are a trader-pilot working your way from star to star, hunting the best deals the universe has to offer.
Aerea (Soedesco, 3rd Sep, $11.99) - The world needs you! AereA is a music-themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?
Arcade Archives SATAN OF SATURN (HAMSTER, 27th Aug, $7.99) - "SATAN OF SATURN" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1981. Fire your missiles and laser beams to take down the UFOs and rockets coming to invade Earth. Clear the Earth stages and blast off for Saturn! Win the decisive battle against Satan of Saturn!
Asdivine Knot (KEMCO, 3rd Sep, $17.99) - A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.
Before Exit: Gas Station (Take IT Studio!, 3rd Sep, $9.99) - Before Exit: Gas Station is anomaly-detection game with dense atmosphere and some unexpected plot-twists. To reveal all its secrets and fully understand it, you will have to play through the campaign several times. In Before Exit: Gas Station, you must close your workplace at night as a gas station employee. But wait, don't gas stations stay open at night? Not in this world! Your boss is very strict and he loves to save money. When night comes, it means you have to turn off the lights, close the store, and go home. It's a gas station in the middle of nowhere, so why would anyone visit this place after dark?
Can I Not Fall for Idols? (Futaba Games, 27th Aug, $4.99) - You've just become the manager of the rookie idol group, "♡Melonchu♡"! To make their debut concert a roaring success, dating any of the active idols is absolutely, 100% off-limits. . . ! And yet, romance flags keep popping up left and right, and the members' affection levels are already at MAX from the very start! How on earth will you navigate this crisis? ! An otome game industry first (! ? )—a slapstick rom-com where romance is strictly forbidden!
Dice A Million (countlessnights, 4th Sep, $12.99) - You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.
EGGCONSOLE Borfes and the Five Demons MSX (D4 Enterprise, 3rd Sep, $6.49) - Released by Crystal Soft in 1987, this classic action RPG returns! One day, the master called apprentice Borfes with a request. Players become apprentice wizard Borfes, embarking on a journey through landscapes like forests and deserts, ultimately setting off to confront the Archfiend Naikin Naikis deep within Naikis Castle. The game features an intuitive top-down view. Borfes starts with only a staff from his master.
EGGCONSOLE PUYO PUYO PC-9801 (D4 Enterprise, 27th Aug, $7.16) - This game is an action-puzzle title released by COMPILE in 1993 in Japan. Gameplay involves clearing falling Puyos by matching four or more of the same color. Players battle head-to-head, strategically managing Puyos. Stacking Puyos to the top means a loss. Clearing large amounts or triggering chains sends Nuisance Puyos to opponents.
FlyKnight (Wabbaboy, 5th Sep, $5.99) - Flyknight tells the tale of a squire of the order of the Flyknights who is assembled to vanquish the witch Lunamoth and lift her curse, which is preventing the denizens of the realm from growing wings. Now separated after an ambush, the squire arriveth at the village of the swamp folk and pledges to see the mission through, either alone or teaming up with other fighters summoned to help along the way.
Gelatinous: Humanity Lost (Nami Tentou, 3rd Sep, $9.99) - Deep in the Amazon, a lone treasure hunter in search of Ultimate Power gets more than he bargains for when he's turned to goo and falls deep into the bowels of an ancient temple. As the gooey treasure hunter, you start with nothing. No powers. No weapons. Not even the ability to jump. Only by exploring the temple can you begin to understand and unleash the powers of the slime. Keep playing to unlock new powers, own your enemies, and hopefully uncover the secret to regaining your humanity.
Hashire HEBEREKE: EX (Gravity, 3rd Sep, $21.99) - Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994 Super Famicom game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT. Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorab le characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to four players, while online multiplayer supports up to eight players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.
Hoversteppers (CheckMate Publishing, 28th Aug, $11.49) - Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.
Isle of Reveries (Electric Airship, 4th Sep, $19.99) - Take control of an owl named Lief as they make a pilgrimage skybound to the forsaken Isle of Reveries, where it's said that any wish can be granted. Players will fight through six mysterious dungeons, each with their own unique themes and puzzles, and meet charming anthropomorphic characters along the way in this retro-inspired adventure.
Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap (FREEMIND, 3rd Sep, $14.99) - In Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap, the ultimate version to experience the game, you’re the proud owner of a once-forgotten junkyard, now brimming with endless potential. Dive into the satisfying world of restoration, recycling, and raw hustle as you transform trash into treasure and rise to become the ruler of the junk empire!
Komorebi – A Furry Visual Novel (Top Hat Studios, 3rd Sep, $19.99) - Komorebi is a fully voice acted story taking place in a dystopian 2041. Set against the backdrop of social revolt, you move to Toronto to start a brand new chapter in your life. Make friends, party, and form bonds and romances that will last a lifetime! While pages turn in your life however, they also turn in the world. As your morals clash with those in power, you and your group may walk an irreversible path in the name of equality and a brighter future. Enjoy your new life. . .
Marsupilami 2 – Salsa Palombia (Microids, 3rd Sep, $29.99) - A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake! The creature behind this crazy beat is none other than the Mummy Queen, back from the Land of the Dead with her minions to play a cursed concert with a calamitous crescendo. Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions!
One-inch Tactics (KOGADO STUDIO, 9th Sep, $19.99) - Kogado Studio, recognized for its simulation games in the early days of PC gaming, has taken on the challenge of simplicity in this title. Beneath the game's simple design lies a deep, strategic complexity.
Order Automatica (Better Gaming Agency, 4th Sep, $5.99) - Like chess with demons, Order Automatica is a tactical roguelite autobattler where every move shapes the outcome. Build your army by placing demons onto a 3×3 ritual board, discover powerful synergies, and adapt your strategy to survive increasingly dangerous encounters. Positioning, timing, and smart combinations are the keys to victory.
Paper Airplane Flying Game (St Pow Games, 4th Sep, $4.99) - A simple paper airplane becomes the start of a quiet and meaningful journey. Lifted by the wind, you guide a fragile creation across a world that feels alive, changing with every new area you reach. What begins as an easy glide slowly turns into a path that asks for attention, control, and a sense of direction.
PLATONICA SPACE (KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO, 27th Aug, $8.29) - == THE STORY == With Earth made uninhabitable to humans, mankind has spread through the universe. A century has passed since that fateful day. . . You suddenly wake up in an unfamiliar room. You step through a door only to find yourself in yet another strange room. This mysterious space is a collection of interconnected rooms, coming one after the other with no exit in sight. Inside the rooms, you run into four other people who, just like you, also have no idea who they are or how they got here. But as you keep exploring, you realize something: these rooms are built from your memories.
Pretty Home Run Derby – Re: Return of KUSOGAKI (Serenity Seeker, 3rd Sep, $2.99) - A high-tempo, high-firepower batting game with overwhelming hit feedback. Wield "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on fearsome foes! Can you bring down the hammer of punishment on "The brat". . . ! ? Once released as "Flail Your Arm, Hit the Ball: Return of KUSOGAKI" now rebuilt from the ground up into something entirely new — and far easier to pick up.
Retrobot: 2085 (Supergonk, 27th Aug, $10.99) - THE ARCADE CLASSICS YOU GREW UP WITH. REBUILT FO R TODAY. The year is 2085. A runaway mega-intelligence called the Algorithm has decided humanity is obsolete, and unleashed millions of networked humanoid robots to make sure of it. You are one of the anomalies: minds the Algorithm could never map, predict, or control. Grab a controller and start fighting back.
Shoe It All! (Amberbite, 3rd Sep, $7.99) - "Growing up is mandatory. Becoming boring isn't. Play as Lace, a rebellious teenager who refuses to fit into a world of rules, order and boring authority. Armed with a swing and a pile of shoes, they'll challenge anyone trying to tell them who to become. Swing, aim and fling your shoes through handcrafted physics puzzles. It looks simple, but every level demands creativity, precision and perfect timing. Master the perfect throw to SHOE IT ALL!
SoulQuest (indie.io, 3rd Sep, $19.99) - When her husband was taken by the gods, Alys refused to accept their verdict. With sword in hand, she embarked on a quest to take his soul back, throwing down the gauntlet to the goddess of death, Morrigan. Neither the legions of godly servants nor the gods themselves will stop her wrath. Welcome to Soul Quest, a hack-and-slash tale of one woman's undying love and boundless grief. Carve through endless hordes of enemies and rip out their very souls. Battle the fates using a deep freeform combat system. Fight the Celtic gods - will you win and complete Alys’ quest?
Star Racer (Crossbridge Game Studios, 3rd Sep, $14.99) - Speed a cross anti-gravity tracks filled with jumps, shortcuts, hazards, and explosive pickups on your way to victory! Get revved up for local multiplayer, challenging Event Races, a powerful Course Editor, and more. - Read our Star Racer review
Where we’re going, we don’t (always) need roads
Tales of Formentera (Ratalaika Games, 4th Sep, $5.99) - Tales of Formentera is an adventure game set on a small island inspired by the real landscapes of Formentera, where old legends shape its history. Something mysterious is happening, and the people of the island need your help to uncover the truth.
Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark (M2, 29th Aug, $34.99) - Toaplan shoot ’em up collection Hishou Same! Same! Same! includes Hishouzame and Same! Same! Same! game. Hishouzame (Sky Shark) (Flying Shark) Nobody ever said it would be easy... Deep in enemy territory, you've got to fly your P-40 on a dangerous top-secret mission. The skies are thick with a deadly rain of armor-piercing fire. They chose you for one reason - you're the best there is! You know the score, so aim right and fly tight. The skies are anything but friendly tonight. Same! Same! Same! (Fire Shark) Communication lines are cut. Military bases lay in ruin. Then out of the smoky haze emerges a phantom biplane. You are Fire Shark, Earth's final defense against this colossal onslaught! - Read our Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark review
Send in the Toaplanes
Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend (Phoenixx, 27th Aug, $23.99) - Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend is a deck-building roguelike fan game based on Touhou Project. One day, Kaguya Houraisan of Eientei held the Lunar Capital Exhibition, attracting visitors from far and wide. But in the midst of the event, its centerpiece—the treasured artifact known as the “Jeweled Branch of Hourai”—was suddenly stolen. Seeking to resolve the incident, Kaguya made an announcement: “Find the missing Exhibit, and I shall reward you with one of my treasures.”
Veiled Edge (GaniTani, 3rd Sep, $16.99) - The year is 2099. The line between reality and the virtual world has disappeared. Step into a fully immersive virtual world powered by cutting-edge Full-Dive technology. Join investigator Rapid and genius hacker Lena as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious series of incidents. Veiled Edge is a 2D action-adventure combining fast-paced combat, detailed pixel art, and diverse gameplay styles.
Loads this week. Orbitals is a priority, but Mewgenics, Isle of Reveries, Valheim, and Moonlighter 2 are all tempting.
And I've always meant to check out Jenny LeClue. I own the Switch 1 version, but never got around to it.
Editor, Nintendo Life
You may select up to 5 answers:
So that's your lot for this week's North American Nintendo Download. Drop a vote in the poll above, and comment below with your hot picks!

item.title: Digimon Story: Time Stranger Is Getting A Major Expansion In 2027
item.description:
With another 50+ Digimon to collect
Digimon Story: Time Stranger is getting a major DLC expansion in 2027 titled A Hero's Eternal Legacy, Bandai Namco has announced.
The new trailer showcases some gorgeous gameplay set in a wide open space with lots of Digimon to take on. In fact, there are over 50 new Digimon to collect in what is being described as "an all-new adventure".
There's no firm release date for this one yet, but it looks good. We'll be keeping a close eye on it.
"In Digimon Story Time Stranger: A Hero’s Eternal Legacy, a new hero emerges as players embark on a journey of courage and friendship through the unexplored lands of Iliad. Along the way, they will encounter more than 50 new Digimon in this all-new adventure."
Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube851k
In our review for Time Stranger, we said that its "monster-battling is as fun as ever, and the time-hopping, dimension-crossing story is a blast from start to finish", awarding it a score of 9/10.
Will you be checking out the upcoming Digimon Story: Time Stranger expansion? Let us know with a comment.

item.title: Classifiche giapponesi: Elden Ring resiste bene, ma viene sconfitto dal campione in carica
item.description:
Frisbee Dog, The Fell Omen
We have another look at the latest numbers for physical game sales in Japan, courtesy of Famitsu, and Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition has put up a pretty good fight in its debut week.
The Switch 2 release dodge rolled onto the podium right from the jump, shifting 27,604 copies. It wasn't quite enough to get that 'Great Enemy Felled' message, though, as the reigning champ, Rhythm Heaven Groove, snatched up another victory.
The chart is awash with new releases this week, with Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 on PS5, Switch 2 and Switch 1 landing in third, sixth and eighth respectively, and Final Fantasy X | X-2 HD Remaster making its Switch 2 debut in seventh.
Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube851k
Here's a look at the top ten in full:
Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition
Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
Final Fantasy X | X-2 HD Remaster
Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters
The hardware standing is in much the same state that we find it every week at the moment. Switch 2 is still in a commanding lead with an additional ~22,000 units to its name, with the PS5 Digital Edition holding onto the silver with 5,866.
Combining the Switch and PS5's respective SKU sales this week actually puts Nintendo in front, with the previous-gen ha rdware combining for 8,847, while Sony's latest pulls in 7,351.
Here's a breakdown of the figures for the week:
PlayStation 5 Digital Edition
Xbox Series X Digital Edition
The Lands Between has more to find
